name: Low Mid Growl
description: The middle up at 550 Hz and the gain past half way: a growling low middle that cuts through heavy guitars.

name: Modern Smile
description: The graphic EQ in, the lows and highs up and the middle down, with bright on: a wide, hi-fi modern sound.

name: Tight Punch
description: The gain at 40 with the middle a little up at 1 kHz: a punchy, even note that sits under a band.

name: Tube Grind
description: The gain high and the tube gain down: the valve drive stage grinds and grows its second harmonic.

name: Ultra Low Slap
description: Ultra low and ultra high on, the treble up: the scooped, bright sound for slap and pop.
